app.name: Water Sources Management Platform
app.tagline: Monitoring sources, pumping, storage and water balance

auth.signInSubtitle: Use the email and password issued to you by Water Management.

errors.generic: Could not sign in. Please try again.
errors.notConfigured: The system is not connected to its database yet. Contact the administrator.

pending.title: Your account is awaiting activation
pending.subtitle: You are signed in as {email}.
pending.body: You cannot view or enter data until an administrator activates your account and assigns your role, areas or measurement points. Contact Water Management.

setup.title: Setup incomplete
setup.body: Supabase keys are not configured. Copy .env.example to .env.local, fill in the values and restart.

saeer.gapWarning: Incomplete data: {missing} measurement points did not report. The figures below are a floor, not a final answer.
saeer.noOfftakeMeters: No route take-off meters are read daily, so the whole difference is shown as unexplained.

entry.title: Daily entry
entry.subtitle: Enter the volume in cubic metres for the operational day shown.
entry.allDone: Every point has been entered for this day.
entry.noTasks: No measurement points are assigned to you.
entry.volumeHelp: The total volume for the period, not a flow rate.
entry.cumulativeIndexHelp: Optional. Used for an independent cross-check later.
entry.recentEmpty: No previous readings for this point.
entry.savedFlagged: Saved and flagged for review because it is far from the usual range. It was not rejected or altered.
entry.correcting: Correcting an earlier reading. The old reading is kept, never deleted.
entry.alreadyEntered: A reading already exists for this day. A correction creates a new row.

errors.volumeRequired: Enter the volume in cubic metres

errors.periodReversed: The end date is before the start date
errors.periodInFuture: A reading cannot cover a future day
errors.periodTooLong: The covered period is too long
errors.pumpHoursRequired: Enter the pump hours, since that is the basis of the number
errors.alreadyEntered: An active reading already exists for that day on this point
errors.periodOverlaps: The period overlaps another reading on this point
errors.notPermitted: You do not have permission to enter readings on this point
errors.saveFailed: Could not save the reading. Please try again.
